method: Each example is built with its own build script against the fixture backend (all four *_C15T_BACKEND_URL variables set, *.inth.app routed to the fixture, other internet hosts blocked) and started with its own start script. Assets are the scripts and stylesheets Chromium received, each phase in a fresh context. Sizes are the response bodies; gzip and brotli use Node zlib defaults per asset. Boundary bytes are the gzip sizes of first-load JS assets that contain a boundary marker string.
